beats.premise: The verse-jump begins: Evelyn glimpses every life she could have lived.
beats.action: The office shreds into a whirl of streaking light around Evelyn. Her face and clothes flicker rapidly through dozens of alternate lives — glamorous, martial, aproned, painted — dozens of Evelyns strobing in place while Deirdre and the desk smear into ribbons of color.
beats.ending_pose: Evelyn frozen mid-flicker, half movie-star and half laundromat owner, staring straight into the camera
visible_consequences: her appearance strobes through many different lives
the office smears into ribbons of streaking light
receipts orbit her like a galaxy

children.premise: The life where she never left Hong Kong: Evelyn the film star.
children.action: The whirl resolves into a night premiere. Evelyn stands glamorous in a sequined emerald gown on a red carpet, hair in an elegant updo, flashbulbs popping. Deirdre is now a reporter thrusting a microphone toward her. Evelyn smiles for the cameras but her eyes are wistful.
children.ending_pose: Evelyn poised under the flashbulbs, chin high, a wistful half-smile held
visible_consequences: red carpet, velvet ropes and popping flashbulbs
Evelyn transformed: sequined gown, elegant updo
Deirdre reappears as a reporter with a microphone

children.premise: Behind the theater, the life not lived finds her anyway.
children.action: Evelyn steps through the stage door into a rain-slicked neon alley, still in her gown. A kind-faced man in a suit waits in the half-light. They face each other, close but not touching, neon reflections rippling in the puddles as she speaks one quiet sentence.
children.ending_pose: the two of them facing each other in the neon rain, almost touching, held
visible_consequences: rainy back alley lit by pink and blue neon
her gown glittering against the wet darkness
puddle reflections rippling with neon light

children.premise: The life on the stage: Evelyn the Peking-opera performer.
children.action: The alley curtains away and Evelyn is mid-performance on a Peking-opera stage in full painted face and embroidered regalia, water sleeves sweeping arcs of white silk, the audience a dark void beyond the footlights.
children.ending_pose: a dramatic opera pose held, water sleeves fully extended, painted face fierce
visible_consequences: full opera makeup and embroidered regalia
white water sleeves sweeping long arcs
footlights against a pitch-dark audience

children.premise: The life of discipline: Evelyn the martial-arts master.
children.action: The whirl resolves into a temple courtyard at dawn. Evelyn, in black silk training clothes with her hair braided, executes precise kung fu forms; the orbiting receipts become falling ginkgo leaves that she strikes from the air one by one.
children.ending_pose: final stance held, fist wrapped in palm, leaves settling around her
visible_consequences: stone temple courtyard in golden dawn light
black silk training clothes, braided hair
receipts become falling ginkgo leaves

children.action: Deirdre strides into the courtyard in her beige office wear wielding a heavy audit ledger like a war fan. They duel with comic seriousness — wire-fu leaps over office furniture that shouldn't be there, the ledger swatting Evelyn's strikes aside in bursts of loose receipts.
children.ending_pose: both frozen mid-air mid-strike, fingers locked, receipts hanging around them
visible_consequences: office furniture scattered incongruously in the courtyard
the audit ledger wielded like a weapon
receipts bursting with each blocked strike

children.premise: The life at the grill — and the secret under the hat.
children.action: A smash transition: Evelyn is a hibachi chef mid-performance at a teppanyaki grill, spatulas flashing. Beside her a rival chef's tall white hat slips, revealing a raccoon perched on his head, tiny paws gripping his hair like reins. Evelyn freezes mid egg-flip, staring.
children.ending_pose: Evelyn frozen mid-flip with the egg hanging in the air, eyes locked on the raccoon
visible_consequences: teppanyaki grill flames and flying spatulas
a raccoon revealed under the rival chef's hat
an egg suspended mid-air over the grill

beats.premise: Everything gathers toward the everything bagel.
beats.action: The office darkens. Above the desk a black everything-bagel void forms and slowly rotates, and the receipts, pens and fluorescent light begin streaming into it. Evelyn grips the desk edge against the pull while Deirdre keeps stamping forms, entirely unbothered, her papers whipping upward one by one.
beats.ending_pose: Evelyn leaning hard against the pull, hair and cardigan streaming toward the bagel, knuckles white on the desk
visible_consequences: a slowly rotating black bagel void above the desk
receipts and pens streaming upward into it
Deirdre stamping forms, unbothered, papers whipping away

children.premise: The universe where evolution took a different path.
children.action: The pull snaps and reality reassembles wrong: the office is pastel-tinted, and both Evelyn and Deirdre now have long floppy hotdog fingers. Evelyn stares at her wobbling hands in horror; across the desk, Deirdre slowly extends one drooping hotdog hand toward her in tenderness.
children.ending_pose: two hotdog hands nearly touching over the receipts, held
visible_consequences: long floppy hotdog fingers on both women
the office tinted in soft pastels
a tender hand reaching across the audit desk

children.premise: In this universe, this is how love looks.
children.action: The tenderness lands: Deirdre dabs a tear from Evelyn's cheek with one floppy hotdog finger. Soft light. In the blurred background a figure plays a piano with bare feet. Evelyn laugh-cries and leans her forehead toward Deirdre's.
children.ending_pose: foreheads leaning together over the desk, hotdog hands clasped, held
visible_consequences: a hotdog finger gently dabbing a tear
piano played with feet, soft-focus background
warm pastel light over the audit desk

children.premise: Chaos wears sequins: the Jobu universe.
children.action: The pastel office bursts into an all-white void. Evelyn stands transformed in an absurd maximalist outfit — glitter face paint, a rhinestone Elvis collar, a pom-pom crown — surrounded by confetti frozen motionless in mid-air. She looks at her own outfit and cackles once.
children.ending_pose: arms flung wide amid the frozen confetti, glitter face tilted up, held
visible_consequences: an endless white void
maximalist glitter outfit with rhinestone collar
confetti hanging frozen in the air

children.premise: The universe where life never happened. At least here it's quiet.
children.action: Total silence. Smash to a sun-baked canyon rim: two boulders sit side by side overlooking the vast empty canyon — one wearing googly eyes, one plain. Wind moves dust between them. White subtitle text appears at the bottom of the frame: 'at least here, it's quiet.'
children.ending_pose: the two rocks side by side on the canyon rim, wind and dust only, held
visible_consequences: two boulders on a canyon rim, one with googly eyes
vast empty canyon under hard sunlight
white subtitle text on the silent frame

children.premise: Even as a rock, she wants to feel something.
children.action: With a gravelly scrape the googly-eyed rock scoots an inch toward the cliff edge. A beat. A second pair of googly eyes pops onto the plain rock, which swivels them toward the edge in alarm. Subtitle: 'don't you dare.'
children.ending_pose: both rocks at the cliff edge, googly eyes fixed on the drop below, held
visible_consequences: scrape marks in the dust behind the moved rock
googly eyes appearing on the second rock
the cliff edge inches away

children.premise: She goes over the edge, joyfully.
children.action: The googly-eyed rock tips over the rim and falls in serene slow motion, the canyon vast and golden below, dust trailing like a comet tail. Subtitle: 'wheeeee.' The plain rock's googly eyes peer over the edge after her.
children.ending_pose: the googly-eyed rock frozen mid-fall against the immense canyon, held
visible_consequences: the rock mid-fall in slow motion, dust comet-tail
the immense golden canyon below
googly eyes peering over the rim from above
